visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black wavy hair, wearing a Flash Wolves esports jersey (dark blue and white with a yellow wolf logo) and a black long-sleeve underlayer, holds a large, intricate golden trophy. He stands on a stage with bright spotlights and confetti scattered across the floor. He looks at the camera with a slight smile and proud expression. (2) He stands still, adjusting his grip on the heavy trophy. A camera lens briefly enters the frame from the right as photographers capture the moment. He then leans in and kisses the top of the trophy while looking down. People in the background are blurred but appear to be watching and taking photos in the large arena. (3) The camera pans quickly to the right to reveal a teammate with braces smiling broadly at the victory. The main subject continues to hold the trophy, interacting with photographers and fans off-screen. The lighting remains bright and dramatic, emphasizing the high-energy atmosphere of the championship win.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Loud ambient crowd chatter fills the arena space as fans and staff celebrate. A distinct female voice is heard shouting 'Chin yi ge!' (Kiss it!) repeatedly in Traditional Chinese with high emotional arousal. Faint electronic background music with a steady rhythmic pulse plays continuously. (2) Multiple rhythmic mechanical shutter clicks from cameras are heard, triggered by photographers capturing the victory pose. These transient sounds occur alongside loud laughter and background murmurs. The vocal intensity remains high as voices call out directions for poses and expressions. (3) As the camera pans, the laughter of a nearby young male becomes more prominent and clear in the mix. The chatter continues without any structural pauses, maintaining a high energy level. The stadium resonance contributes to a dense acoustic environment typical of a live event.
